backgrounds.title: 晴空手绘
backgrounds.wide_prompt: Premium light-colour illustrated conference portrait backdrop, 16:9 landscape. Warm off-white paper texture, airy sky blue and pale mint colour fields, soft hand-painted clouds and distant landscape. Reserve the left 46% as calm continuous space for one portrait. Place only a few playful RISC-V-inspired circuit tiles, wafer arcs and tiny geometric technology motifs in the right third, designed like refined editorial illustration rather than realistic hardware. No person and no readable text.
backgrounds.vertical_prompt: Premium light-colour illustrated conference portrait backdrop, 2:3 vertical. Warm off-white paper texture with airy sky blue, pale mint and restrained coral accents. Keep the central 80% calm and continuous for one large portrait. Decorative technology motifs are sparse, small and limited to the outer corners; total decorative coverage below 12%. No person and no readable text.
backgrounds.negative_prompt: No people, face, body, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, border, card frame, photo frame, white rectangle, dark panel, realistic giant processor, busy code, dense props or heavy shadows.
